scope: Resource-first H1 deployment preflight for the committed Byte Buddy 4.3.0 cartridge and required authored-art sidecar on the recorded pink Waveshare unit 1; no firmware flash, OS update, H2 storage write, or P4G transfer was attempted

h1_preflight.historical_marker: P4_FILE_TRANSFER READY protocol=2 p4g_max=524288 p4r_max=8388608 exchange_max=8388608
h1_preflight.safety_decision: Stopped immediately. The live endpoint on the recorded pink bridge contradicted the historical protocol-2 marker and rejected P4R before any data chunk. Sending P4G alone, probing the green unit, disguising the resource class, or assuming the historical firmware identity is forbidden.

deployment_next_step.required_user_action: On the physically identified pink unit, open System and select Turn On USB Mode, then connect H2 to the Mac.
deployment_next_step.identity_gate: Before any copy, require the newly enumerated TinyUSB mass-storage serial to end in the recorded pink node identity B289 and require a FAT32 P4GAMES volume.
deployment_next_step.install_note: The guarded installer verifies the complete generated bundle including BYTEBUD.P4R and BYTEBUD.P4G. Copying P4UPDATE.P4U does not install it; any OS update still requires a separate explicit Game Manager confirmation and fresh authorization.
deployment_next_step.h1_retry_gate: Do not retry P4R over H1 until the live pink firmware identity and a protocol-2 ready marker are re-established.

limitations: This record proves a fail-closed live H1 preflight and zero content mutation; it does not prove installation or cartridge readback.
The historical August 30 record proves that this bridge previously ran protocol 2, but no current evidence explains the live capability regression.
